SELECT cp.subcategory, p.subcategory AS subcat_on_date, p.category AS cat_on_date,
       count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus,
       sum(f.quantity) AS units, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_rows, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
       min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS l0, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS l1
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  AND (cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' OR p.subcategory='Interior Paint')
GROUP BY ALL

WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
), ip AS (
  SELECT b.* FROM base b JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=b.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE cp.subcategory='Interior Paint'
)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM ip GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM base) AS all_units_fact,
 (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02') AS all_units_rpt,
 (SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN ip ON ip.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id) AS ip_units_returned,
 (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM ip WHERE channel_code<>'ST' OR channel_code IS NULL) AS nonST_units,
 (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM ip) AS ip_units,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ip WHERE sale_date NOT BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02') AS out_of_range
